name: BailingHub 业务后台
description: 让 WorkBuddy 直接查询和操作已接入 BailingHub 的业务后台，最终权限与业务规则仍由你的系统决定。
description_zh: 让 WorkBuddy 直接查询和操作已接入 BailingHub 的业务后台，最终权限与业务规则仍由你的系统决定。
description_en: Let WorkBuddy operate systems connected to BailingHub while your system keeps final control.
examples_zh: 查看最近 7 天订单，并把异常订单整理出来
把库存低于 10 件的商品找出来，生成并执行补货计划
把员工资料修改为我刚才提供的内容
为这笔订单发起退款，如果需要审批先告诉我进度
examples_en: Review orders from the last seven days and list the exceptions
Find products with fewer than ten units and execute a replenishment plan
Update the employee profile with the details I just provided
Start a refund for this order and tell me if approval is required
